_comment: Refill for the 0.9 m pair13 main sweep: 7 roi4 blocks gave up on 9 October (solo ambient A drifted past the 10% limit for a sustained stretch at both 8 and 10 degrees per side: d090_t080_r2_roi4, r3, r4 and d090_t100_r2_roi4, r3, r4, r5). Repeats 1 for each angle already exist and passed, so this regenerates all 5 repeats at each angle for roi4 only; keep repeats 2-4 (8 deg) and 2-5 (10 deg) from this run when merging and discard the rest as redundant. Same calibration as rq3_jessica_0p9_pair13.json. If the same sustained ambient drift shows up again, wait a few minutes for it to settle before starting rather than retrying immediately. Run: python -m rig session --guided --port COM7 --config configs/rq3_jessica_0p9_pair13_refill_t8t10_roi4.json --out data --tag refill
